Nitish setu ke udghatan samaroh men pradhanmantri narendr modi ko dekhne ke lie bari sankhya men log pahunche.
Karyakram men pahunche logon se piem modi aur nitish kumar ki jori ko lekar kya kaha sunie...
'bihar tak' (Bihar Tak) ek aisa manch hai jahan khabron se lekar itihas tak sabkuchh hai. to garv se kaho, ham bihari hain.
